metadata.title: Supernovae without host galaxy? - Hypervelocity stars in foreign galaxies

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's targets are host-less supernovae in external galaxies; its retained HVS candidate is the inferred progenitor of SN 2006bx in UGC 5434, explicitly described as an HVS in a foreign galaxy rather than one unbound from the Milky Way (T:p9-b3, T:p10-b4; I:p6-b0). The named HE 0437-5439 and HD 271791 are only literature-context objects, not targets studied here (T:p2-b6, T:p2-b7).
